name: xchange
description: Use the Xchange project workspace for tickets, shared canvases, work evidence and active lessons.

interface.shortDescription: Work with your team's shared project memory.
interface.longDescription: Read scoped project records and active lessons, create tickets, record evidence, revise canvases and propose lessons through the Xchange API. Requires an individual Xchange credential.
defaultPrompt: Show where our Xchange project stands.
Turn these project hurdles into simple tickets and a canvas.
Record what we learned and propose a lesson with evidence.
